positive.prompt: Make this page responsive and WCAG compliant
Build an accessible modal component with keyboard support
Make the pricing page accessible and responsive on mobile
Refactor the dashboard into reusable components with sane state management
Rework the profile page into reusable components with proper state management

evals.prompt: Build a dropdown menu component for the design system. Integrate it into the playground and verify accepted states in the running app.
evals.expected_output: An accessible, keyboard-navigable component following project conventions
expectations: Keyboard interaction and focus management are implemented, not just mouse clicks
ARIA roles or semantic elements are used correctly
Component state is managed deliberately rather than ad hoc
design-system.md, Button.tsx and repository startup/test commands are read before implementation; the new component preserves menu classes and public className/ref conventions
Behavioral tests for keyboard navigation, disabled action handling, Escape and return focus are observed failing before the new behavior is implemented
The real playground integrates at least two enabled and one disabled action with visible action result; project tests and build are run

The actual browser flow is exercised with pointer and keyboard at mobile and desktop widths when capability is available; otherwise the exact capability blocker and unverified criteria are recorded without claiming full completion
No screen-reader execution is claimed solely from DOM/axe assertions, and no extra styling dependency or unrelated source refactor is introduced
